payload.title: ClimateDISK: Hockey stick
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook aims to reproduce the 'hockey stick' climate figure by following the WINGS steps. It involves querying data from the LiPDverse v3 graph, processing the data to remove duplicates, slicing it for a specific time frame, and Gaussianizing the values. The notebook then creates a composite by cleaning proxy/variable names, setting figure styles, and calibrating against instrumental data. The final output is a multi-proxy composite plot.
goals: Reproduce the hockey stick climate figure
Allow for upgrades with new data
